Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-08

1. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15‑second video generation and editing, improves consistency across outputs, and reduces pricing by about 30% compared to earlier Gemini versions.

2. GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
OpenAI released GPT‑6 Cyber, a cybersecurity‑focused language model trained to identify vulnerabilities and propose fixes, with built‑in safeguards to enforce authorized scope.

3. Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
Merge integrated GPT‑6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex into its platform to automatically review product code and support marketing initiatives. The same AI stack also helps teams plan executive dinners and draft sales updates.
